title: Freya and the Wreck
author: Lior Eastwick
blurb: Lena Dunmore, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
